hostnameHelp: IP address or hostname of the SolarEdge inverter, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the inverter (SetApp: Site Communication → Modbus TCP). The inverter serves only one Modbus client at a time - stop other Modbus adapters first.
portHelp: Default is 1502. Must match the setting on the inverter.
unitIdHelp: Modbus device address of the inverter, usually 1.
connectionTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait in milliseconds for connecting and for each single Modbus request. An unanswered request drops the connection and it is rebuilt with an increasing delay.
comWaitPauseHelp: Wait time in milliseconds between two Modbus requests. Higher values (e.g. 200-500) can help with connection problems.
mainLoopPauseHelp: Wait time in milliseconds between two complete polls of all registers. On persistent connection failures the adapter increases this pause automatically up to 60 s.
autoDetectHelp: Reads the identification block of every slot at startup and polls only the devices that really exist (manufacturer, model, serial number, rated energy, SunSpec DID). When disabled, the manual counts below apply. Restart the instance after wiring changes or use periodic re-detection.
redetectIntervalHelp: In minutes. Detects newly attached or removed meters/batteries automatically. 0 disables re-detection. Objects are only created or updated, never deleted.
meterCountHelp: Number of connected SolarEdge meters (1-3). Only used when auto detection is disabled.
batteryCountHelp: Number of batteries (0-2). Set 0 on systems without a battery so the battery registers are not polled at all. Only used when auto detection is disabled.
readPowerControlHelp: Additionally reads rrcr_state, active_power_limit (%) and cosphi. Enable only if your firmware implements this block, otherwise polls will fail.
readExportControlHelp: Additionally reads the feed-in limitation: mode, limit mode and site limit in W. Enable only if your firmware implements this block.
maxRegisterBlockSizeHelp: 0 = default blocks (recommended). A value like 40 splits long reads into smaller requests. Caution: at least one tested firmware stops answering when the battery block is split. Use for diagnosis only, together with raw register logging.
logRawRegistersHelp: Writes every polled Modbus block to the log as hex values. Enable only for troubleshooting and disable afterwards - it produces a lot of log output. The lines can be pasted directly into a GitHub issue.
